note: Hand-placed and named, per S12. There is no drop table in this build and no generator wrote any line below. Weights are in units of 1 kg; `value_gold` is gold, which is the only currency (S15). Descriptions are 12-45 words and are about the OBJECT: RI-UIX03 §C caps the ratio of item text to dialogue at 0.05 because AR-2 makes item descriptions replacing dialogue as the lore vector an automatic fail. Proper nouns used here (Lilmoth, Stormhold, Helstrom, Gideon, Blackrose, Dres, the Hist, the Legion, the Ledger) are all corroborated in game/data/dialogue/ — that is §C's fourth row, and it is what makes an item allude to the world rather than constitute it.

items.name: Reed-cutter
items.description: A working blade with a bill-hook curve near the tip, made for standing water and used on people since. The grip is bound with the same twine the fish-weirs use.

items.name: Warden-issue sabre
items.description: Legion pattern, made in Gideon under contract and stamped on the ricasso. The stamp is the valuable part; the steel is ordinary and rusts in a week if you do not oil it.

items.name: Hooked gutting knife
items.description: Short, hooked, and worn thin on one side from being sharpened wrong for years. Every household on the Lilmoth waterfront has one and nobody would call it a weapon.

items.name: Bog-iron maul
items.description: Iron smelted out of marsh ore, which is poor iron, so the head is enormous to make up for it. It is heavier than it needs to be and everyone who carries one knows.

items.name: Sapwood bow
items.description: Grown rather than cut, over eleven years, by a woman in Helstrom who will not sell to Dunmer. The limbs still smell faintly of sap when they are warm.

items.name: Chitin cuirass
items.description: Plates lifted whole off something large and lashed to a root frame. The joins are visible and are meant to be; a chitin-worker signs their work in how the segments overlap.

items.name: Boiled hide jack
items.description: Guar hide, boiled hard, cut for someone with a broader back than yours. It stops a knife once and then it does not.

items.name: Legion greaves, worn
items.description: Imperial issue, two sizes of dent, and someone has scratched a tally of thirty-one marks inside the left one. Nobody in Stormhold will tell you what the tally counted.

items.name: Shell-scale hauberk
items.description: River-shell scales sewn onto reed cloth, nacreous where the light catches along the sewing line. Cool against the skin, loud in the rain, and worth more than the house it came from.

items.name: Rootweave cowl
items.description: Woven from live root and kept damp so it does not crack. It keeps the sun off and it keeps nothing else off.

items.name: Factor's coat
items.description: Cut in the Imperial style, dyed a green that does not occur in the marsh, and mended twice at the elbow by someone who was not paid to be good at it.

items.name: Wet-season boots
items.description: Soled with three layers of hide and laced to the knee. They are made to be walked in wet and to be dried slowly, and they crack if you dry them fast.

items.name: Dres silk sash
items.description: House Dres weave, in the colour a factor wears to be recognised at a distance. Wearing it in Lilmoth is a statement, and it is not a safe one.

items.name: Black-water draught
items.description: Bitter, silty, and it works. The recipe is common from Blackrose to the coast and every household changes one ingredient so that theirs is the real one.

items.name: Fever-cut
items.description: For swamp fever, taken hot. It does not cure it. It moves the worst of it into one very bad night instead of nine ordinary ones.

items.name: Sleeper's draught
items.description: Sold in Gideon as a sleeping aid and bought for other purposes. The seller is careful to say, aloud and in front of witnesses, what it is for.

items.name: Marsh-marrow root
items.description: Pulled from standing water, pale, and edible if you have nothing else. Alchemists want it for the second thing it does, which is stop bleeding.

items.name: Hackle-lo leaf
items.description: Chewed by everyone who works outdoors and disapproved of by everyone who does not. It stains the mouth a colour that a Legion officer can recognise across a room.

items.name: Kwama cuttle
items.description: Traded down from Morrowind in sealed jars because it spoils in a day out of them. Half of what is sold under the name is not.

items.name: Comb resin
items.description: Amber, viscous, and still warm when it is cut out. It is used in enchanting and in glue, and the people who cut it do not do the enchanting.

items.name: On the Drowning at the Ford
items.description: A thin volume, badly bound, by a man who was not there. Copies turn up all over the coast because it was cheap to print and flattering to the wrong people.

items.name: Pilot's chart-book, Topal shore
items.description: Not a map. A pilot's written directions for the shore run, in the order you meet the landmarks, with the wrong ones crossed out and the crossings-out argued with in a second hand.

items.name: Ledger leaf, water-damaged
items.description: One page out of a Provincial Office ledger, soaked and dried. Eleven names are legible. The column that says what was done to them is not.

items.name: Reed lantern
items.description: A resin candle in a woven cage. It burns for about four hours and it makes you visible for about four hundred paces, which is the whole problem with it.

items.name: Shore compass, boxed
items.description: A needle in oil under a shell lid, in a box you have to stop walking and open. It tells you where north is. It has never told anyone where anything else is.

items.name: Bone picks, set of five
items.description: Cut from a bird's wing bones and filed. They break easily, which is why they come in fives, and carrying them is an offence in Gideon whatever you say they are for.

items.name: Factor's weighing stone
items.description: A standard weight, stamped, for arguing with people about what a sack weighs. Two of the four faces have been quietly ground down.

items.name: Fire-drill and tinder
items.description: It takes a long time in this climate and everyone carries one anyway. The tinder is kept in a stoppered gourd because nothing here is dry by accident.

items.name: Salt brick
items.description: Pressed salt from the flats, the size of a fist, used for trade inland where coin means less. It gets smaller in your pack if you are careless about rain.

items.name: Carved egg
items.description: An eggshell with a face cut into it, the sort a hatchling is given and keeps or does not. This one has been kept a long time by somebody.

items.name: Shell cup, cracked
items.description: River shell, polished inside, split down one side and mended with resin by somebody who wanted to keep it rather than replace it.

items.name: Coil of weir twine
items.description: Forty feet of it, waxed, the kind the fish-weirs are strung with. It is the single most useful object anyone in this province carries and nobody sells it for anything.

items.name: Dried guar
items.description: Salted, dried and hard enough to hurt your teeth. It keeps for a season in this climate, which no other food here does.

items.name: Reed-case writ, stamped
items.description: Your case, stamped at the Writ House. It is the only thing in the province that says you are a person rather than a shape in the water.

items.name: Key, hall
items.description: Iron, pitted, and too large for its ward. Somebody filed the bit down to make it fit a lock it was not cut for.

items.name: Sealed letter, Stormhold
items.description: Wax over a cord, unbroken, addressed in a clerk's hand to a name and not to an office. You were told to carry it and not told what is in it.

items.name: Bark token
items.description: A palm-sized disc of Hist bark with three notches in the rim. Everyone who sees it knows what it means and nobody has yet explained it to you.

items.name: Crate tally, three counts
items.description: Three columns in three different hands, and they do not agree. That is the entire reason anyone is interested in it.

items.name: Flask of lamp resin
items.description: Thickened resin for a lantern, in a clay flask with a thumbprint fired into the shoulder. It burns slowly and it will not stop burning if it spills.

items.name: Netting needle
items.description: Bone, flat, notched at both ends for mending net. A person who owns one and cannot use it is noticed.

items.name: Warden's whistle
items.description: Bone, two notes, and every warden within earshot is required to come. It is worth a great deal and it is worth nothing to sell.

items.name: Moth-silk robe
items.description: Pale, weightless, and entirely wrong for this climate. It was brought here by someone who expected to be leaving again.

items.name: Root-speaker's rod
items.description: A forearm of black bog-oak, bound at both ends, worn through in the middle where a hand has held it. It focuses nothing by itself. It gives the words somewhere to go.

items.name: Mud-slip bowl
items.description: Clay Moor work: matte, crazed, four thumbprints in the foot where it was lifted off the wheel. Every household from here to the ridge has a stack of them.

items.name: Inkhorn, iron-gall
items.description: A stoppered horn of the black ink the Provincial Office insists on, because it bites into the page and cannot be lifted off again without taking the page with it.
